name: Robotic Pivot (Fluid)
description: The pivot has a range of motion of 0.25 turns in both directions. A standard input value sets the target orientation within the pivot's range of motion. The measured rotation of the pivot can be read from its output. The pivot's speed can be configured by selecting it with the select tool.
shortDescription: A robotic pivot that will orientate towards the input value within its range of motion.

logicNodes.label: Rotation Target
logicNodes.description: The standard value setting the orientation within the range of motion.

logicNodes.label: Current Rotation
logicNodes.description: The pivot's measured rotation between -0.25 and 0.25.
